items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: No, I don't, uh, remember him because most of the bands around Chicago, I mostly knew of, you know, by way.

ctx.x: What about, uh, Tommy Ladinier? Did you ever know him in Chicago?
He was from down here. In Mandeville. I thought maybe you knew him.
